Which French musician, known for the song "Nightcall", died on 28 July 2026?

[Kavinsky] Vincent Pierre Claude Belorgey (31 July 1975 – 28 July 2026), known professionally as Kavinsky, was a French DJ, record producer and actor. His production style is reminiscent of the electropop film soundtracks of the 1980s. Kavinsky said that his music was inspired by thousands of films he watched as a young boy and he grabbed the best parts from them, consolidating them into one concept. Kavinsky has been compared to French house artists including Danger and Daft Punk. He achieved greater recognition after his song "Nightcall" was featured in the 2011 film Drive. His debut studio album, OutRun, was released in 2013, followed by Reborn in 2022.
